inlines.v: STUMP, noun [G.] 1. The stub of a tree; the part of a tree remaining int he earth after the tree is cut down, or the part of any plant left in the earth by the sythe or sickle. 2. The part of a limb or other body remaining after a part is amputated or destroyed; as the stump of a leg, of a finger or a tooth. STUMP, verb transitive 1. To strike any thing fixed and hard with the toe. [Vulgar. 2. To challenge. [Vulgar.]
